The complete guide to Document Understanding in UiPath:

Your robots can click and type in any system.

But most company data hides inside documents: Invoices, contracts, passports, resumes.

Document Understanding is how
UiPath
reads them.

Here is the full technical setup in Studio:

1. Install the package
→ UiPath.IntelligentOCR.Activities
→ It unlocks the Taxonomy Manager and every activity below.

2. Build your taxonomy
→ The blueprint of the project: Your document types and the fields you want extracted.
→ Example: Invoice with Invoice No. (text), Date (date), Amount (number).

3. Digitize
→ Digitize Document runs OCR on the file.
→ You get the raw text plus a Document Object Model: Where every word sits and how confident the OCR is.

4. Classify
→ Classify Document Scope decides what type of document the robot is looking at.
→ A Keyword Based Classifier recognizes it from typical words like "Invoice" and "Amount".

5. Extract
→ Data Extraction Scope pulls the fields you defined.
→ A Form Extractor uses a template: Upload one sample document and mark where each field lives.

6. Export
→ Export Extraction Results converts everything into a DataSet.
→ Write it to Excel, a database, or your ERP.

The same 6 steps handle passports, resumes and contracts. Only the taxonomy changes.

Free resources to master it:

📺 I recorded a complete 34-minute guide where I build this whole setup from scratch:
https://lnkd.in/eaRN2-Jt
→ UiPath Academy's free Document Understanding course:
https://lnkd.in/eJE5km_W
→ The official documentation:
https://lnkd.in/ep3QAesi
Save this one for the day a folder of PDFs lands on your desk.

No coding needed. You can do it.
